name: Hotel Ergriffen
original_name: Hotel ergriffen-ホテル エァグリッフェン-
source:
Man sees three prostitute girls on a street corner and invites them to his his place. This is a story of five intoxicated days in their company. From everyday life sympathy is born, and the image of an ideal woman appears...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-october-2001-jisatsu-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一名男子在街角看見三名妓女，邀她們到自己住的地方。這是與她們共同度過的五個迷醉日夜。平凡相處中漸漸萌生共鳴，理想女性的形象也隨之浮現……

[譯自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-october-2001-jisatsu-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
